params_missing.message: Cannot identify payment records for fraud hit without required parameters: (1) fraud_hit_identifier — unique ID or reference for the confirmed fraud hit, (2) fraud_membership_criteria — operational signature (device fingerprint pattern, payment method pattern, geographic anomaly, transaction sequence, amount threshold, or incident reference ID) determining which payments belong to this hit, (3) archived_scope — time range, archive status flag, or data source definition for older archived payment history.
